**SECTION D: ESSAY.** Write an essay of 250 to 300 words on any one of the following topics.

**Topic 1.** Environmental pollution in my country.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
La rédaction anglaise du BAC sanctionne autant le respect du format imposé (essai descriptif sur un problème national, essai d'opinion « for or against », lettre formelle de plainte) que le contenu. Un essai sur la pollution doit donner des exemples concrets et locaux plutôt que des généralités abstraites ; un essai « for or against » exige une position personnelle claire soutenue par des preuves issues de l'expérience réelle, comme la consigne le demande explicitement ; une lettre de plainte formelle à un responsable de chaîne de télévision respecte les codes administratifs habituels (adresses, objet, formule d'appel et de politesse). Comme le sujet propose un choix, un seul texte doit être rédigé le jour de l'examen ; les modèles ci-dessous illustrent chacun l'un des formats possibles.

## Topic 1 - Essay on a national problem (modèle, environ 270 mots)

Environmental pollution has become one of the most visible problems in my country, affecting our towns, our rivers and increasingly our health.

In our cities, the most obvious form of pollution comes from the mountains of rubbish that pile up on street corners, since waste collection services rarely keep pace with the amount of refuse a growing population produces. Motor vehicles, often old and poorly maintained, release thick black smoke that fills the air in busy neighbourhoods, especially during traffic jams that can last for hours. Industrial areas, such as Bassa in Douala, expose nearby residents to toxic chemical waste discharged directly from factories, with serious long-term consequences for people's health.

Our rivers have not been spared either. Many factories and households discharge waste water directly into streams and rivers, contaminating the very sources some communities still rely on for drinking water. Plastic waste, in particular, now clogs waterways across the country, worsening flooding during the rainy season because water can no longer drain properly.

The consequences of this pollution reach far beyond simple inconvenience. Respiratory illnesses linked to air pollution are becoming more common, particularly among children living near busy roads or industrial zones. Waterborne diseases spread more easily when rivers are contaminated, placing an additional burden on an already stretched healthcare system.

Solving this problem will require sustained effort: stricter enforcement of environmental regulations on factories, genuine investment in regular waste collection services, and public education campaigns that help ordinary citizens understand why proper waste disposal matters, not only for the environment but for their own health and that of their children.

**SECTION D: ESSAY.** Write an essay of 250 to 300 words on any one of the following topics.

**Topic 2.** Are you for or against early marriages? Support your arguments with strong evidence from real life experience.
questions.corrige_markdown:
## Topic 2 - Opinion essay: for or against (modèle, environ 260 mots)

I am strongly against early marriages, and my position comes not only from principle but from what I have personally observed in my own community.

A cousin of mine was married at sixteen, shortly after failing her BEPC, because her family believed marriage would settle her future more reliably than continuing her education. Within two years, she had two children and had never returned to school. Today, entirely dependent on her husband's income, she often tells me she wishes she had been given the chance to finish her studies before starting a family. Her story is not unique; I have heard similar accounts from at least three other girls in my neighbourhood alone.

Beyond individual stories, early marriage carries real risks that evidence consistently confirms. Girls married and pregnant before their bodies are fully developed face significantly higher risks of complications during childbirth. Girls who marry young are also far less likely to complete their education, which limits their ability to support themselves financially if the marriage later fails or if their husband cannot provide for the family alone.

Some argue that early marriage protects girls from the risks associated with premarital relationships, or eases financial pressure on struggling families. I understand these pressures, but I believe they treat a symptom, poverty and limited opportunities, by creating an even greater long-term problem for the girl herself.

Based on what I have witnessed in my own family and community, I remain convinced that delaying marriage until a girl has completed her education and can make an informed, independent choice serves her, and ultimately her future family, far better than an early marriage ever could.

**Topic 3.** Write a letter to the General Manager of RTL9 to complain about a TV programme that you want him to cancel because you find it inappropriate. Your name is Nangfang Kymko and your address is P.O. Box 77777, Yaoundé, Cameroon.
questions.corrige_markdown:
## Topic 3 - Formal letter of complaint (modèle, environ 220 mots)

Nangfang Kymko
P.O. Box 77777
Yaoundé, Cameroon

The General Manager
RTL9

Subject: Complaint regarding an inappropriate television programme

Dear Sir,

I am writing to express my concern about one of the programmes currently broadcast on your channel, which I believe is inappropriate for the wide audience, including many children, who watch RTL9 during its broadcast hours.

The programme in question contains scenes of graphic violence and language unsuitable for young viewers, broadcast at a time when many families, including mine, are gathered in front of the television together. I have personally witnessed my younger siblings imitating aggressive behaviour after watching certain episodes, which I find deeply troubling.

I understand that television channels must offer varied programming to remain competitive, but I believe this particular programme crosses a line that responsible broadcasting should not cross, especially without adequate warnings or a later broadcast time reserved for more mature content.

I would respectfully request that RTL9 either cancel this programme entirely or move it to a much later time slot, accompanied by a clear content warning, so that parents can make informed choices about what their children watch.

Thank you for taking this concern seriously. I look forward to your response.

Yours faithfully,

Nangfang Kymko
